decision_criteria.raw_linear_yes: Median per-head LO-realization-out AUC >=0.65, median R2 >0, and >=10/16 heads AUC >=0.65; alpha selected from [0.1,1,10,100] by inner realization-held-out CV.
decision_criteria.raw_linear_no: Median per-head AUC <=0.60, median R2 <=0, and fewer than 8/16 heads AUC >=0.65.
decision_criteria.raw_nonlinear_yes: Pooled OOF AUC >=0.65, median fold AUC >=0.60, >=3/4 folds AUC >=0.60, and >=8/16 heads AUC >=0.60.
decision_criteria.raw_nonlinear_no: Pooled OOF AUC <=0.55 and at most 4/16 heads AUC >=0.60.
decision_criteria.encoder_destroys_signal: Encoder median head AUC <=0.60 and R2 <=0, plus usable raw linear probe improves median head AUC/R2 by >=0.10, or usable raw nonlinear probe improves median head AUC by >=0.15.
decision_criteria.observation_insufficient_yes: Both raw probes NO (no cross-realization usable ΔQ signal), and the prior encoder probe is also weak. Any small AUC difference is reported but does not establish a usable generalizable signal being destroyed.

protocol.outer_cv: Leave-one-realization-out 4-fold; every slot of held realization excluded.
protocol.inner_cv: For each outer training set, choose ridge alpha using held-realization-out CV over the three training realizations.
protocol.scaling: Each fold fits feature and target centering/scaling only on its training rows.
protocol.nonlinear_probe: Pooled Linear(409,32)-ReLU-Linear(32,1); append one-hot physical head index; manual NumPy full-batch gradients, Adam lr=1e-3, L2=1e-3, exactly 200 epochs, fixed fold seeds 20260925+fold; no early stopping.
protocol.raw_context_capture_source: SimpleTransition.cache_contexts stored by production rollout; same conditional context supplied to sample_cache_trigger

comparison_to_prior_encoder_probe.comparison_note: Like-for-like AUC deltas compare median per-head OOF metrics; nonlinear pooled AUC is separately reported.

static_source_field_presence_map.finding: ConfigurationObservationSpec stores cache-node/service IDs as layout metadata and allocates vector slices for cache state, UAV positions, predicted vehicle positions, predicted popularity, optional horizon mask, and optional time-to-go. No dedicated trigger-head ID coordinate is allocated.
Observation construction consumes previous cache state, UAV positions, predicted vehicle positions/popularity, and optional horizon/time-to-go to form the vector.
The same conditional context is constructed in the cache-node loop and passed to sample_cache_trigger with node_index separately.
